ranked_evidence.title: ASC Engineered Solutions Acquires Ward Manufacturing | ASC Engineered Solutions
ranked_evidence.snippet: **Oak Brook, IL and Blossburg, P.A., February 2, 2024 –** ASC Engineered Solutions (“ASC”), a leading provider of flow management solutions, including precision engineered pipe joining systems, flow control products, support solutions and related services, announced today that it has acquired Ward Manufacturing (“Ward”) from Proterial America, Ltd., a subsidiary of Proterial, Ltd. Ward is a leader in the manufacturing of pipe joining components including fittings, nipples and the WARDFlex® corrugated stainless steel tubing system. “Ward has a well-earned, strong reputation for rigorous quality control and reliable customer service – key attributes that we greatly value at ASC,” said Jason Hild, Chief Executive Officer of ASC. “The addition of Ward’s complementary products strengthens ASC’s core portfolio and enables us to bring the productivity-enhancing WARDFlex® solutions to our customers. Building on nearly a century of quality manufacturing, using only the best, most durable materials and advanced technology and techniques, Ward has become a fixture in the global pipe fittings industry.
